name: Membrix Membership For WooCommerce
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Membrix Membership For WooCommerce adds practical free membership features usually scattered across multiple plugins.

Core features:

  • Unlimited membership plans
  • Plan durations, optional trials, and drip delays
  • Assign plans automatically from WooCommerce product purchases
  • Restrict posts, pages, and products by plan
  • Optional redirect page for locked content
  • Member-only discount percentages per plan
  • Expiry reminder emails (daily cron)
  • Member status shortcode: [MMFW_membership]
  • Protected block shortcode: [MMFW_protected plan_id=”123″]…[/MMFW_protected]
  • Simple admin reports table
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-membership-for-Membrix/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Create plans from Membership Plans
  5. Assign plans to products in product edit screen
  6. Restrict content using the Membership Restriction meta box

short_description: A free, production-minded WooCommerce membership plugin with plans, content restrictions, drip rules, trial support, member discounts, reminder emails …
